title: MiniMax Music v2.6
description: MiniMax Music 2.6 creates complete tracks with singing, backing music, and detailed arrangements from lyrics and a style description.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: A description of the music style, mood, genre, and scenario. 10-2000 characters.

inputs.name: lyrics
inputs.tooltip: Lyrics of the song. Use \n to separate lines. Supports structure tags: [Intro], [Verse], [Pre Chorus], [Chorus], [Post Chorus], [Hook], [Bridge], [Interlude], [Transition], [Build Up], [Break], [Inst], [Solo], [Outro]. Max 3500 characters. Required when is_instrumental is false. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: lyrics_optimizer
inputs.tooltip: When true and lyrics is empty, auto-generates lyrics from the prompt.

inputs.name: is_instrumental
inputs.tooltip: When true, generates vocal-free instrumental music.
